reserveReview.rationale: The October 29 metals-backing publication itemizes USD 62,914,159.850411 of gold lease, USD 31,987,920.440000 of silver lease, USD 25,362,670.749171 of futures account and USD 4,997,500.000000 of secured credit, plus USD 296,455.170000 of metals cash, totaling USD 125,558,706.209582; the gold and futures lines are flagged estimated and silver, secured credit and metals cash complete, with zero open breaks. The thUSD historical API's latest row, timestamped 2026-10-29T18:00:10Z, reports USD 204,434.152273 USDC, USD 20,000 USDT and USD 9,218,634.756088806 thBILL, totaling USD 9,443,068.908361806. The dashboard pairs those two clocks, so total reserves are USD 135,001,775.117943806 and every weight is 100 times its published amount divided by that total, with no percentage rounding. This review therefore replaces the single aggregate gold-carry line with the issuer's own four-way metals itemization: the October 9 book reported one USD 103,721,175 gold-carry position, whereas October 29 discloses a USD 125,558,706 metals and secured-credit book split into lease, margin and credit lines, and thBILL has fallen from USD 29,350,639 to USD 9,218,635. The two clocks are not simultaneous and the metals valuation is an issuer estimate for gold and futures margin; neither is an independent assurance. Internal lease-book allocation between MG999 and other lessees, the split of the futures account between T-bill collateral and cash margin, and the secured-credit obligors and collateral remain undisclosed, so those lines are unlinked exogenous exposures rather than dependencies.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Theo rendered transparency dashboard dated October 29, 2026, pairing the published metals-backing valuation with the latest thUSD historical composition row; full-reserve percentages computed from those published USD amounts
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The split of the futures account between T-bill collateral and cash margin, the allocation of the gold and silver lease books between MG999 and other lessees, and the secured-credit book's obligors, collateral and tenor are not published; each is reported only as an aggregate. The metals-backing gold and futures values are issuer estimates rather than completed valuations. The reserve-side split of staked versus unstaked backing is likewise not published.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: At Ethereum block 26088438, the disclosed Cash Wallet 0xec417ccb6dd26868cca993a92f37217b1d4b3c2f is a 4-of-5 Safe v1.4.1 with no modules and zero guard, receiving mint collateral. Theo's gold-carry explanation names Standard Chartered, Libeara, FundBridge and Wellington and claims CFTC-segregated futures margin at an unnamed US-regulated Fortune-500 FCM, but no account-level attestation, custody agreement or provider allocation is linked. These offchain provider roles and safeguards remain issuer claims; Libeara's tokenization role is not independent evidence of custody of every gold leg. MG999 bankruptcy remoteness and first-loss protection are issuer claims confined to that fund, not independently verified safeguards for the complete gold-carry slice or other reserve legs. The amount, availability and allocation of first-loss protection are not independently verified. Aggregate bankruptcy remoteness, segregation, rehypothecation terms and provider shares remain unknown.
